paragraphs.text: Meaning, that he has not forsaken her, but through her own opportunity as in Ho 2:2.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Who would declare that I have cut her off: meaning, that they could show no one.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Signifying, that he sold them not for any debt or poverty, but that they sold themselves to sins to buy their own lusts and pleasures.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: to whom I have sold you

paragraphs.text: He came by his prophets and ministers, but they would not believe their doctrine and convert.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Am I not able to help you, as I have helped your fathers of old, when I dried up the Red sea, and killed the fish in the rivers, and also afterward in Jordan?
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: As I did in Egypt in token of my displeasure, Ex 10:21.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: The prophet represents here the person and charge of them that are justly called to the ministry by God's word.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: me the tongue of the learned

paragraphs.text: To him that is oppressed by affliction and misery.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: As they who are taught, and made meet by him.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: I did not shrink from God for any persecution or calamity. By which he shows that the true ministers of God can look for no other recompense of the wicked, but after this sort, and also that is their comfort.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Showing that it is a rare thing that any should obey correctly God's true ministers, though they labour to bring them from hell to heaven.
paragraphs.label: l
paragraphs.anchor: Who is among you that feareth

paragraphs.text: You have sought consolation by your own devises, and have refused the light and consolation which God has offered: therefore you will remain in sorrow and not be comforted.
paragraphs.label: m
